confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated price-guide data from several sources that disagree by up to about 50 percent, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced; they are set at a multiple of the beer anchor, as the local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not inspected listings, so they are lower confidence. FX is the RBA 4:00 pm rate for 2026-11-18 as reported on the RBA exchange rates overview page; it was located through search, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a provincial Philippine city below Manila, with food and drink benchmarks drawn from Manila and Palawan (El Nido) aggregated guides, and accommodation benchmarked to budget and mid-range Philippine tourist towns.
